test_title: PYST 58: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held  on 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

The precarious case of juvenile / deliquency against him / was dismissed by the / jury in the first hearing.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the phrase "**delinquency against him**", the word "**deliquency**" is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**delinquency."**
 
• **Spelling errors** can change the meaning of a sentence or make it confusing.

Hence, the correct statement is : ***The precarious case of juvenile delinquency__ against him was dismissed by the jury in the first hearing.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Correct spelling** is crucial for clear communication and keeping the intended meaning intact.
 
• Commonly** misspelled** words should be** double-checked **to ensure accuracy.
 
• **Spelling tools and dictionaries **can help identify and correct spelling errors.
